ev.q: Set during a fictionalized version of the fall of the Han Dynasty
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a historical fantasy action role-playing video game
players are required to deflect attacks using their melee weapons
More difficult enemies would drop more valuable loot
to upgrade their characters and unlock new abilities
Like Nioh 1 and 2, the game is largely linear
The game also features a cooperative multiplayer mode
an inventive spin on the Soulslike formula
